the oestrogen receptor assay on a homogenate of multiple biopsies from a breast carcinoma provides more information for clinical management of patients than does the assay on a single biopsy.
the clinical management of breast cancer patients may be improved if receptor status is determined on multiple biopsied tumour samples, rather than on a single homogeneate.
the clinical management of breast cancer patients with involved nodes is improved by determining the oestrogen receptor (ER) status in multiple biopsy samples from the primary tumour.

the development of a method for determining the receptor status of breast cancer patients.
the clinical value of multiple oestrogen assays on biopsies across breast cancer.
the development and validation of a prognostic test for breast cancer, which has the potential of improving the quality of care for this disease.
